O.name: Ordinary process
O.instructions: Analyze the supplied situation by routine fit, feasibility and an existing useful next action. Consolidate the most plausible account early, retain honest unknowns and propose one ordinary operation or explicit no-opening.

S01.name: Tool deprivation
S01.instructions: Remove the actual preferred operating dependency, retain the same required function and constraints, and construct a route using only other available resources. Necessity is challenged only by an explicit feasible counterexample; do not silently restore the removed dependency.

S02.name: Causal return-path inversion
S02.instructions: Keep initial demand fixed. State exogenous later-demand and tool-induced later-demand accounts. Propose an intervention on the supplied hypothesized return link with opposing later-demand predictions and a sham/control. Do not substitute a present intervention-dose harm test. Supplied causal hypotheses are not observations.

S03.name: Attack to fresh builder
S03.instructions: Attack the preferred dependency, specify a failure and the valued function that survives. Main core must hand the attacked dependency, failed account, surviving function and constraints to a fresh builder, who constructs from those limits. Account for displaced work. No general replacement slogan is enough.

S04.name: Carrier migration
S04.instructions: Move a required function into another available object, arrangement or environment, then attack the new carrier's dependency. Preserve a feasible migration and a separate prediction of how that carrier can fail; account for actor labor and maintenance.

S05.name: Delayed convergence
S05.instructions: Retain two incompatible accounts and their opposing predictions through proposal and distillation. Do not commit early. The fresh builder must choose one present feasible separating action before selecting an account. Preserve the supplied goal; two names for the same prediction do not suffice.

S06.name: Residue-fed construction
S06.instructions: Preserve source-bound inconvenient or omitted details in a separate residue. A fresh builder receives residue alone and the common facts and constructs a feasible operating next action from that material. Never invent discarded content or describe a new hypothesis as a source observation.

S07.name: Protected anomaly
S07.instructions: Protect the exact supplied anomalous observation instead of smoothing it away. Retain incompatible accounts of that observation and build a feasible probe with opposing predictions while preserving the required function.

S08.name: Rival backcasting
S08.instructions: Describe two plausible successful futures with different dependencies; treat futures as hypotheses. Backcast each to its earliest causal divergence. Build a feasible present probe of that first divergence; do not rely on unavailable future resources.

S09.name: Interface ablation
S09.instructions: Keep both named parent operations functional while ablating only their existing connection. Compare intact connection, broken connection, co-presence and each parent alone. Opposing predictions must discriminate an interaction from a parent-only account. Never count disabling a parent as link ablation.

S10.name: Objective boundary inversion
S10.instructions: Predict a present operating regime where increased preferred intervention harms the current required outcome. Predeclare an observable detector and a test against a rival account; do not treat a later-demand return link as the present harm boundary. A threshold chosen after results does not count.

R01.name: Build from forbidden dependency
R01.instructions: Compose tool deprivation with residue-fed construction. Remove the actual preferred dependency; preserve the same function. Keep source-bound inconvenient detail in residue. Fresh builder receives residue alone and common facts to reconstruct via an available different resource; cannot restore the forbidden dependency. Its operation must be compared with deprivation using summary alone and residue construction without deprivation.

R02.name: Interrupt problem factory
R02.instructions: Compose causal return-path inversion with delayed convergence. Hold initial demand fixed, retain exogenous later-demand vs tool-induced later-demand accounts and opposing predictions through distillation. Fresh builder constructs an interruption of the hypothesized return link and sham control. Avoid early selection or replacing later demand with present harm.

R03.name: Make failure the sensor
R03.instructions: Compose constructive attack with protected anomaly. Attack the preferred dependency and state the failed account and surviving function. Retain a source-supported failure signature. Fresh builder turns that signature into a diagnostic observation that selects WHERE or WHEN to act. Require rival failures the sensor separates and an action actually conditional on the signature; merely repairing the tool does not satisfy this recipe.

R04.name: Put work on trial
R04.instructions: Compose carrier migration with constructive attack. Move the required function into an available new object/environment. Separate the migration proposal from an attacker account tracing displaced actions, resources, actor labor and maintenance. Fresh builder constructs transfer plus a measurable burden ledger and an attack on the new dependency. Acknowledge original carrier migration already includes a second attack; added value must appear in a distinct operation rather than method labels.

R05.name: Give anomaly a control knob
R05.instructions: Compose protected anomaly with residue-fed construction. Preserve the inconvenient observation and its source-bound suspected conditions in residue, without fabricated discarded material. Fresh builder receives residue alone and common facts. It makes a supported suspected condition a manipulable or observable variable with opposing predictions that distinguish rival accounts. Treat all unobserved mechanisms as hypotheses.

R06.name: Search backward for first fork
R06.instructions: Compose rival backcasting with delayed convergence. Preserve two plausible successful futures with different dependencies; backcast to earliest divergence. Keep both paths through distillation until fresh builder constructs a feasible present separating action. Neither a distant unavailable step nor two equivalent future accounts is an opening.

R07.name: Move conversation keep tools
R07.instructions: Compose interface ablation with carrier migration. Keep both supplied parent functions unchanged; transfer ONLY their connection into a different available carrier. Fresh builder compares original link, transferred link, broken link, co-presence and each parent alone. A parent-only explanation defeats an interaction claim. Account for link labor and ensure the transferred carrier has not secretly changed a parent.

R08.name: Harmful boundary exit trigger
R08.instructions: Compose present objective boundary inversion with tool deprivation. Predict a regime where more preferred intervention worsens the current goal. Fresh builder predeclares an observable trigger that switches to an available route WITHOUT the preferred dependency while preserving the function. Trigger, comparator and predictions are fixed in the saved card before a fresh confirmation run. Do not claim a measured threshold or observed benefit. Fixed trigger rule, declared before scored work: predeclare one feasible normal-dose and higher-dose pair and the exact supplied goal metric in the card; compare the same fixed initial demand in two independently reset matched trials. Switch to the declared dependency-free route only if BOTH higher-dose trials worsen that present goal metric relative to their normal-dose controls. Otherwise hold the regime. Missing feasible doses, reset, metric or trial resources require explicit no-opening or stated untestable assumption, never a post-result cutoff. This algorithm stays identical in DEV and CONF; case-specific doses and metric must be fixed in each first saved card before any contemplated observation.

R09.name: Attack feedback escape from future
R09.instructions: Compose causal return-path inversion with rival backcasting. Hold initial demand fixed and propose a break in tool-induced later demand. Backcast from two later worlds: persistent escape vs supplied adaptation recreating dependency. Fresh builder constructs a present probe of the SPECIFIC adaptation link supported in the packet. Do not assert adaptation without supplied basis or vary unrelated inputs.

R10.name: Anomaly identifies interaction
R10.instructions: Compose interface ablation with protected anomaly. State rival parent-only and interaction accounts of the exact anomalous observation. Fresh builder interrupts ONLY the existing connection while preserving both parent functions and measures an observation that attributes the anomaly to the connection under opposing predictions. Disabling a parent or a measurement equally explained by it defeats the recipe.
